question: Which state in India will you find the The Cathedral of Mary Help of Christians ?
solution:
The correct answer is __**Meghalaya**__.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• **The Cathedral of Mary Help of Christians is a Roman Catholic church** situated in **Shillong's Laitumkhrah neighborhood**, 3.5 kilometers from the bus terminal.
 
• It is also referred to as the **Cathedral Catholic Church.** It is Shillong's main house of worship and one of the city's most well-known tourist attractions.
 
• **In Shillong, Meghalaya, India, there is a church called the Cathedral of Mary Help of Christians.**
 
• It serves as the **Metropolitan Archbishop of Shillong's **residence and is the cathedral church of the Shillong Roman Catholic Archdiocese.
 
• It covers the **East Khasi Hills and Ri-Bhoi districts**, which contain 35 "Parishes" or church districts.
 
• The main venue of worship for the more than **342,169 Catholics in the Shillong Archdiocese is the Cathedral,** which was constructed more than 50 years ago.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• **The Cathedral of Mary Help of Christians**

 
 
• **​**The Cathedral Church of Mary Help of Christians was constructed by the Germans in 1913 and is dedicated to **mother Mary.** The first church was destroyed by a fire accident in 1936, and this led to the creation of the current shrine, according to history.
 
• After the Catholic Church had been present in **Northeast India for 100 years, **it was given the title of a shrine in 1980.
 
• The main place of worship for the about 300,000 Catholic residents of** Ri Bhoi and the East Khasi Hills district of Meghalaya** is this church, which is part of the **Shillong Roman Catholic Archdiocese.**
 
• The church was built in the **Gothic style** and is perched on an emerald-colored hill. The church is surprisingly huge and is most likely the biggest in Meghalaya.
 
• The interiors feature stained glass windows, **terracotta cross stands**, and a** bronze cavalry monument.**
 
• **Hubert D'Rosario, Shillong's first archbishop**, is buried there. Inside the chapel, there is a variety of artwork depicting passages and scenes from the Bible as well as the biographies of many saints. It also contains an underground chapel grotto dedicated to **Our Lady of Lourdes **that was cut out of a mound.
